blocks.text: This article provides information for managing Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) customers using APIs. All APIs are rate limited. To learn more, see About Rate Limiting.

blocks.heading: Getting Authentication Domains for a Customer

blocks.text: To get authentication domains for the customer:

blocks.item: Send a GET request to the endpoint /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/authdomains in the customer-controller.
Provide the customerId, the ZPA tenant ID of the customer, in the request endpoint. For example: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/217246660302995456/authdomains.

blocks.text: A successful response returns code 200. To learn more, see About Error Codes.
